revision_summary: One quote-timestamp error and a few targeted fixes needed before shipping: (1) Fix script_coverage[7].tax_credit_qualifier.customer_quote — 'No. I no. Only 6650 or something.' is timestamped 02:05 but actually occurs at 02:48-02:50; 02:05 is the rep asking 'Do you have a credit score over 670?'. Correct the ts field. (2) Add a cherry_pick_moments entry for 03:35 ('I know that some of the NGO, making the, what, the grand grand program...') — this is the clearest moment the customer's root mental-model confusion becomes explicit, and the rep's non-response to it deserves standalone classification (knowledge_gap or curiosity_creation_failure), not just a slot in the multi_touch_patterns table. (3) In cherry_pick_moments[4] (intro_legitimacy_omission), correct the reasoning — intros.standard does not require a state mention (that's an intros.tesla criterion); reframe the legitimacy critique around intros.standard's actual success_signals (reference_to_form_submission, human_pause_for_response). (4) Clarify or drop the outcome_dispute's reference to an 'unknown/see transcript' v1 tag since no such prior tag is shown in this artifact — either state what baseline tag is being disputed or rephrase as a straightforward outcome classification (dq) rather than a 'dispute' against an unstated value. (5) Optionally strengthen the objection_inversion_miss coaching_implication at 02:52 to acknowledge that no bill amount was ever collected in this call, so the 'anchor was never built' framing should note this was structurally unavailable at this early, trust-contested stage rather than reading as a simple rep oversight.
